title: Foreign Trade Relations in Sri Lanka in The Ancient Period: With Special Reference to The Period from 6th Century B.C to 16th Century A.D.
author_or_institution: J. M. Sudharmawathie / University of Kelaniya
scope: Mahatittha, Jambukolapattana, Uraturai, Gokanna, Godavaya and changing Sri Lankan port geography
limitations: Conference/repository synthesis drawing on earlier historical and archaeological literature; site-specific chronology should defer to excavation/epigraphic publications where available.

title: Networks and social cohesion in ancient Indian Ocean trade: geography, ethnicity, religion
author_or_institution: Seland / Journal of Global History / Cambridge University Press
scope: Monsoon seasonality, resident merchant communities, trading diasporas and trust networks in the Indian Ocean
limitations: Indian Ocean-wide mechanism; does not by itself date the first permanent Muslim settlement in Sri Lanka.

title: Islamic trade, shipping, port-states and merchant communities in the Indian Ocean, seventh to sixteenth centuries
author_or_institution: Michael Pearson / The New Cambridge History of Islam
scope: Islamic shipping and merchant communities across Swahili coast, Maldives, Malabar, Coromandel and Sri Lanka
limitations: Regional synthesis; early Sri Lankan settlement dates require local epigraphy and specialist scholarship.

title: The Muslims of Sri Lanka: One Thousand Years of Ethnic Harmony, 900-1915
author_institution: Lanka Islamic Foundation; historian formerly University of Colombo
scope: Muslim merchants, Kandyan integration, Portuguese/Dutch displacement, ports and inland commercial roles
limitations: Interpretive framing emphasizes long-term harmony; episode-level claims should be cross-checked against Portuguese/Dutch records and newer scholarship.

title: Merchants, Maidens, and Mohammedans: A History of Muslim Stereotypes in Sinhala Literature of Sri Lanka
author_or_institution: Alexander McKinley / Journal of Asian Studies
scope: Muslims in Sinhala literature; early-colonial displacement into the interior; colonial production of Muslim categories and stereotypes
limitations: Focus is literary representation and stereotype formation rather than a comprehensive demographic history.

title: Banishment and Belonging: Exile and Diaspora in Sarandib, Lanka and Ceylon
scope: VOC Ceylon as exile site for Javanese/eastern Indonesian royalty, rebels, convicts, slaves and troops; formation of Sri Lankan Malay community
limitations: Community formation is heterogeneous; not all ancestors were Muslim, exiles, or voluntary migrants, and later identity formation was gradual.

title: Economic and Political Factors in the 1915 Riots
author_or_institution: Kumari Jayawardena / Journal of Asian Studies
scope: Economic grievances, Coast Moor commerce, nationalism and colonial context of 1915
limitations: Part of an older symposium; use with later reassessments for orchestration and violence dynamics.

title: The Action Phase of the 1915 Riots
author_or_institution: Charles S. Blackton / Journal of Asian Studies
scope: Spread of 1915 violence and British martial-law repression
limitations: Older framing and terminology; retain later historiographic corrections.

title: Ceylon's Kristallnacht: A Reassessment of the Pogrom of 1915
scope: Evidence for wider orchestration, rumours and organized violence in 1915
limitations: Strong interpretive term `pogrom`; causal weighting remains historiographically debated.

title: Census of Population and Housing 2024 — religion
author_or_institution: Department of Census and Statistics, Sri Lanka
limitations: Contemporary metric belongs to post-1948 corpus; religion and ethnicity are separate census dimensions.
